product_3.sql: SELECT d.d_year sale_year,d.d_moy sale_month,i.i_category category,COUNT(*) row_count,SUM(ss.ss_quantity) total_quantity,SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) total_net_paid,SUM(ss.ss_net_profit) total_net_profit FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk=i.i_item_sk WHERE ss.ss_item_sk=3 AND d.d_date BETWEEN '1999-01-01' AND '1999-12-31' AND ss.ss_quantity>=0 GROUP BY d.d_year,d.d_moy,i.i_category ORDER BY d.d_year,d.d_moy,i.i_category LIMIT 24
